blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Hospitals and emergency response teams across Metro Manila will be placed under code white alert from Oct. 31 to Nov. 2 in preparation for a possible increase in patients requiring immediate medical attention during the Undas break. The Department of Health-Metro Manila Center for Health Development (DOH-MMCHD) said the alert aims to strengthen the readiness of health facilities and healthcare workers as people travel and visit cemeteries to observe All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day.
